source.title: Keystone metro cost factor (BLS OEWS wages, see README cost method)

factor.note: MSA 31180 Lubbock, TX: labour index L=0.746, materials M=1.0. 5/5 trades (OEWS May 2024 via O*NET Texas local-wages search extracts). Ratios to US: 47-2031 0.673; 47-2111 0.760; 47-2152 0.770; 47-2061 0.791; 49-9021 0.802. L = 0.746; factor = 0.40*0.746 + 0.60*1.00 = 0.9. M=1.00 (default, no public citable reason to adjust).

cost.method: Factor = 0.40*L + 0.60*M, rounded to 2 decimals. L = weighted mean of (metro annual median wage / US national annual median wage) for SOC 47-2031 Carpenters (0.30), 47-2111 Electricians (0.20), 47-2152 Plumbers/Pipefitters/Steamfitters (0.20), 47-2061 Construction Laborers (0.20), 49-9021 HVAC Mechanics/Installers (0.10), from BLS OEWS; weights renormalised over occupations available for the MSA. M = materials index, 1.00 for all Texas metros (no public citable reason to adjust); qualitative materials notes per MSA. Wave 2 (2026-10-11): all five trades retrieved from O*NET Texas local-wages pages (OEWS May 2024) via search extracts (Secondary); HVAC missing for 28660, 47380, 46340, 17780 (weights renormalised there). provisional removed for every MSA with >=4 trades.

source.title: Lubbock CIAC City Comparisons (2025-05-12), roadway impact fee

plainLanguage: Lubbock builds new homes under the 2021 International Residential Code with city amendments and the 2021 energy code (climate zone 3B). The most common new-home zoning is SF-2 under the 2023 Unified Development Code: lots of at least 5,000 sq ft and 40 ft wide, with 20 ft front, 5 ft side and 15 ft rear setbacks and a 35 ft height limit. A front-facing garage must sit at least 20 ft back. The city's design sheet sets 115 mph wind, 15 psf snow and a 12 in frost line. Hail is frequent and severe, so Class 4 shingles are a smart choice, though not required. The building permit runs about $0.11 per sq ft (roughly $310 for a 2,400 sq ft house with garage), and roadway impact fees of up to about $3,150 can apply depending on location. Near playa lakes, floors must be raised above flood levels.
